name: Church Fellowship
overview: Church fellowship is a vital expression of the believer's unity and commitment to Christ, centered on gathering in His name where He promises His presence among them. The early church devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread, and prayer, demonstrating the importance of communal spiritual growth and mutual encouragement. Believers are called to let Christ's word richly dwell within, teaching and admonishing one another through worship, while actively provoking love and good works. Consistent assembly and exhortation are essential, especially as believers anticipate Christ's return.
